subject: Andrews and McGlynn Schools Infrastructure Financing
overview: The Council authorized a $30.7 million financing package for school HVAC and roof repairs and approved the program year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Action Plan. It also passed a resolution demanding noise and light mitigation at the new West Medford commuter rail platform.

items.title: Recognition of Marie Cassidy and Chevalier Theater Update
items.summary: Adopted a resolution congratulating Marie Cassidy on her retirement from the Medford Family Network and referred a request for a Chevalier Theater status update to the Public Works and Facilities Committee.

items.title: CDBG Program Year 2025 Action Plan
items.summary: Approved the program year 2025 Annual Action Plan and five-year consolidated plan for Community Development Block Grant funding following a public hearing.

items.title: West Medford Commuter Rail Mitigation
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that Keolis and the MBTA reduce light and sound levels at the newly installed West Medford platform due to neighbor complaints of 24-hour noise and excessive brightness.

items.title: Boston Glory Food Truck Permit
items.summary: Approved a seasonal food truck permit for Trolley Dogs to serve spectators at Hormel Stadium during professional ultimate frisbee games.

items.title: McGlynn and Andrews School Infrastructure Financing
items.summary: Approved $5,000,000 in free cash and authorized a $25,775,000 loan order for new boilers, cooling systems, and roof repairs at the McGlynn and Andrews schools.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust CPA Appropriation
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $50,000 from the Community Preservation General Reserve to the Medford Affordable Housing Trust Fund for development awards.

items.title: School Security and Claim Settlements
items.summary: Appropriated $198,000 in free cash for school security upgrades, including cameras and electronic access controls, and $31,766.01 to settle various insurance claims.

items.title: Floodplain Ordinance Update
items.summary: Approved the first reading of an ordinance update to adopt revised FEMA Flood Insurance Rate Maps and updated definitions effective July 2025.

items.title: Car Wash Sign Permit Appeal
items.summary: Approved an appeal allowing the replacement of pre-existing signage at a Fulbright Street car wash after a dispute over the sign's active status.

items.title: Public Participation on Immigration Enforcement
items.summary: A resident expressed fear regarding ICE activity in Medford and urged the city to strengthen its status as a sanctuary city.
